channel.title: Governance Digest: sky
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: SAEP-25: Update the Allocation System Primitive (sky)
item.description: Phoenix Labs proposes SAEP-25 to update the Allocation System Primitive section of the Spark Artifact, recording wound-down instances, rate limit IDs and current controllers.

item.title: [November 19, 2026] Proposed Changes to Spark for Upcoming Spell (sky)
item.description: Proposed changes for the Spark spell of November 19, 2026: seven changes across Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Unichain, Avalanche and X-Layer, including deprecating Spark Liquidity Layer on OP Mainnet, Unichain and Avalanche, and December grants of 865,000 USDS and 45,000 USDS.

item.title: Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle Proposal - Week Of 2026-11-09 (sky)
item.description: Core GovOps submits the weekly Atlas Edit proposal for the week of 2026-11-09: edits include adding weETH as Morpho vault collateral with a 60,000 weETH cap, new Morpho vault governance rules, and monthly grants to the Spark and Grove foundations.

item.title: PSM-GUSD-A and PSM-PAX-A housekeeping (sky)
item.description: Sidestream proposes a core spell to fully offboard two inactive legacy PSM collateral types (PSM-GUSD-A and PSM-PAX-A) from Sky's on-chain records.

item.title: Risk Month in Review: October 2026 (sky)
item.description: BA Labs' October report covers a Stability Scope parameter change, stUSDS keeper rate settings and Treasury Management Function figures for the Sky Ecosystem.

item.title: Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle Proposal - Week Of 2026-11-02 (sky)
item.description: Core GovOps submits this week's Atlas edits, including temporary capital ratio requirements and a larger exposure limit for Osero's Gauntlet USDC vault instance.

item.title: Sky Ecosystem Q3 2026 Quarterly Report (sky)
item.description: Sky Frontier Foundation published the Sky Ecosystem Q3 2026 Quarterly Report, citing net revenue of $37.19 million, up 11.8% quarter on quarter.

item.title: Osero cBEAM Configuration (sky)
item.description: A Sky forum thread sets up public reporting for the Osero Configurator Bounded External Access Module (cBEAM), which can adjust rate limits for the Osero Diamond PAU within governance-set bounds.

item.title: Reduce ABC Step 2 to 25%, increase Staking emissions 50% (sky)
item.description: A forum post proposes cutting the share of Step 2 capital retained for the Aggregate Backstop Capital from 50% to 25%, which would raise Step 3 staking rewards and buybacks by 50%.

item.title: [November 5, 2026] - Skybase Foundation Grant: 900,000 USDS SubProxy Transfer (sky)
item.description: Skybase requests a 900,000 USDS transfer from its SubProxy to the Skybase Foundation Operational Multisig, via the November 5, 2026 Executive Vote, to cover operating costs and partner payouts through the end of 2026.

item.title: Technical scope of the Beacon and Configurator launch on Base (sky)
item.description: Proposes launching the PAS/Configurator module on Base so trusted operator groups can adjust rate limits and remove facets on Spark's Diamond PAU without a spell, with the Timelock initially paused.

item.title: SLL pilot request: Zyfai as a $10M rate-limited USDC venue on Ethereum (sky)
item.description: Zyfai asks for feedback on a 90-day pilot where Spark's Liquidity Layer would allocate up to 10M USDC to a Zyfai-managed Safe that rebalances across Ethereum USDC lending venues.

item.title: [November 5, 2026] Proposed Changes to Spark for Upcoming Spell (sky)
item.description: Spark's 5 November spell proposes six changes on Base and Ethereum, including a new Base controller and USDC route to Ethereum and onboarding OUSD, plus one Sky Core change.
